title: Black rivers, white springs: the colours of the world's place names
excerpt: I found 138,453 places named after a colour, in 20 languages. Rivers run black, springs run white, the commonest colour name on Earth is Cerro Colorado, and a fifth of Russia's red is revolutionary.
seo_description: 138,453 places named black, white, red, green, blue or yellow in 20 languages, mapped: black rivers, white springs, red flags.
header_alt: Title card reading 'The colours of the world's place names' in black and red on parchment, beside a world map covered in small dots in black, white, red, green, blue and yellow, with the lines '138,453 colour names in 20 languages', '37% of rivers are black' and '43% of springs are white'.
